title: A gate naming a tokenize module function (tokenize.generate_tokens, tokenize.tokenize) is still classed secrets
goal: A gate whose only secret word is a name of the tokenize module's API (tokenize.generate_tokens, tokenize.tokenize(f.readline), tokenize.TokenInfo) is classed by its other words, and a gate naming an API token, GITLAB_TOKEN or a credential file stays secrets

run:
import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_authority as a
it={'touches':['_tools/bl_check.py']}
qs=['Use tokenize.generate_tokens to find comments?','Does tokenize.tokenize(f.readline) read bytes?']
r=[a.class_reasons(it,dict(id='g1',question=q,options=['one','two']))[0] for q in qs]
print(r);sys.exit(0 if r==['design','design'] else 1)

import sys
sys.path.insert(0,"_tools")
import bl_authority as a
def cl(q,t):return a.class_reasons({"touches":t},{"id":"g1","question":q,"options":["one","two"]})[0]
mod=[cl(q,["_tools/bl_check.py"]) for q in ("Use tokenize.generate_tokens to find comments?","Does tokenize.tokenize(f.readline) read bytes?","Keep tokenize.TokenInfo in the scan?")]
real=[cl(q,["_tools/bl_check.py"]) for q in ("Rotate the API token of the service account?","Where is the GITLAB_TOKEN kept?","Store the credential file in _private?")]
print("tokenize module gates:",mod,"| API token and credential gates:",real)
sys.exit(0 if "secrets" not in mod and all(r=="secrets" for r in real) else 1)
